newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers steady-lower, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers steady-lower, wheat flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were flat to lower on Thursday while corn and wheat values steadied, dealers said.
Dealers cited scant movement in soybeans and wheat.
"It is dead," one soybean dealer said. He noted continued spread activity on the Chicago Board of Trade soybean futures and a lack of export demand.

On the export front, Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 50,000 of Canadian wheat and 20,000 of Australian wheat and 20,000 tonnes of Australian barley at its weekly tender.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture said U.S. soybean sales to China totaled 55,000 tonnes in the week ended July 24.
